FT-002.adaptation: Accepted FT-002 revision 4 at input main 81f02dc under allocation openai-kabir-plus-ft002-stage4. Three of the four child streams named in the objective are already delivered on this branch: reusable incremental state (6b13034), scoped macro expansion and preamble handling (01fb13c), project-relative multifile dependencies with per-file source identity (3ae7d9b), and independent equivalence and performance evidence (benchmark plus byte-identical-to-clean-build assertions, rerun by me). Issue #8 reproductions should already pass and will be verified against its exact JSON lines. Issue #9 is the real remaining work: the compiler emits fraction bars as box-drawing text and Greek/radical as Unicode, which crates/pdf cannot encode in base-14 and silently turns into question marks. Rev 4 forbids silent glyph substitution, so this needs a shared representation or a tested adapter; crates/pdf belongs to FT-009 and will not be edited from here.

next_action: Awaiting the two contract decisions asked for on issue #9: a rule item type and an optional font field. Available for dispatch.

origin/main.adaptation: Caught and fixed a regression I introduced: the new export warning was downgrading valid documents to status recovered, dropping the corpus from 9 ok to 6. recovered means the compiler recovered from a source error, and a document containing a fraction is not malformed, so export warnings are now added after status is computed and do not affect it.
